questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) (i) Briefly explain the difference between data and information. (2 marks)

(ii) Identify three forms that data can take. (3 marks)

(iii) Give one input device that can be used to input each of the forms of data in a(ii). (3 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Data and information (2 marks).** **Data** is a collection of raw facts, figures or symbols (for example the numbers 12, 15 and 9, or the word "Ngwa") that have no meaning on their own. **Information** is data that has been processed, organised and given a context so that it is meaningful and useful for decision making (for example "the class average is 12"). Data is the input of processing and information is its output.

**(ii) Three forms of data (3 marks, 1 each).** Data can take the form of:

1. **text** (letters, words, characters);
2. **numbers** (numeric data);
3. **images** (pictures, graphics);
4. **sound** (audio);
5. **video** (moving pictures).

Any three of these are accepted.

**(iii) One input device for each form (3 marks, 1 each).**

| Form of data | Input device |
|---|---|
| Text | Keyboard |
| Numbers | Keyboard (or numeric keypad) |
| Images | Scanner (or digital camera) |
| Sound | Microphone |
| Video | Video camera (or webcam) |

The device must match the forms chosen in (ii): for example, if the three forms chosen are text, images and sound, the answers are keyboard, scanner and microphone.

(ii) State the function, and briefly explain the specification for the following devices:

- 4GB RAM
- 500GB HD

(4 marks)

(iii) Briefly explain what is meant by the specification **4.6GHz dual core CPU**. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Table 1 (6 marks).** Hardware is the physical, touchable part of the computer; software is the set of programs and instructions that run on it.

| Specification for Hardware | Specification for Software |
|---|---|
| Intel Celeron 4.6 GHz dual core CPU | Windows 7 Professional (operating system) |
| 4GB RAM | Avast Antivirus (utility / application program) |
| 500GB HD (hard disk drive) | |
| DVD/CDRW (optical drive) | |
| W/less LAN NIC (wireless network interface card) | |
| Touchpad (pointing device) | |

**(ii) RAM and hard disk (4 marks).**

- **4GB RAM (2 marks).** *Function:* RAM (Random Access Memory) is the main memory of the computer. It temporarily holds the programs and data that the CPU is currently using, so that the CPU can read and write them very quickly. *Explanation:* 4GB is its capacity: about four billion bytes of programs and data can be held at the same time. RAM is volatile, so its content is lost when the power is switched off. More RAM allows more programs to run together and makes the computer faster.
- **500GB HD (2 marks).** *Function:* The hard disk drive is the secondary (backing) storage device. It stores the operating system, the application programs and the users' files permanently, even when the computer is switched off. *Explanation:* 500GB is its storage capacity: about five hundred billion bytes (files, photos, programs) can be kept on it.

**(iii) 4.6GHz dual core CPU (2 marks).**

- **4.6GHz** is the clock speed of the processor: the CPU's clock ticks 4.6 billion times per second (4.6 billion cycles per second), so the higher the figure, the more instructions it can execute each second.
- **Dual core** means that the CPU chip contains two independent processing cores, so it can carry out two instructions or tasks at the same time (better multitasking and performance than a single core).
